title: Liquid blob background
description: Playing with SVG goo filters and CSS animation to get a lava-lamp effect without canvas.
notes: Runs fine on desktop, chugs on older phones. Parking it here until I find a lighter approach.

title: Skyrim: Overcast Overhaul
description: A small weather mod that biases the random weather table toward overcast/rain in northern holds.
notes: First real modding project. Learned way more about weather state machines than I expected to need.

title: ESP32 plant moisture sensor
description: Wi-Fi soil moisture sensor that was supposed to text me when my plants needed water.
notes: Sensor corroded after three weeks in soil. Need to pot it in resin before trying again.

title: Dotfiles rewrite, take 3
description: Rewrote my whole shell config to be modular per-machine instead of one giant file.
notes: Third rewrite in three years. Hopefully the last one.
